itens.trecho: Um dos melhores filmes que o Brasil exportou internacionalmente. Sendo eu português, creio que conheço razoavelmente melhor as realidades do Brasil do que a generalidade dos estrangeiros. Afinal, os laços históricos e culturais ligam os dois países até aos nossos dias.

One of the best films that Brazil exported internationally. Being Portuguese, I believe that I know the realities of Brazil reasonably better than most foreigners. After all, historical and cultural ties connect the two countries to this day.
Decent movie with lots of strongly violent action. It stands up because it is staged in Rio and created by Brazilians. The plot is not very surprising but good enough.
